name: proxy-tools
reason: The existing pywebview dependency has no upstream wheel; build it once for release, never on an end-user machine.
license_note: The original module and upstream LICENSE.txt state BSD-2-Clause, although old package metadata says MIT. Include the complete upstream LICENSE.txt in the wheel without changing the module.
build: Extract verified source; add verified upstream LICENSE.txt; use setuptools 84.0.0 build_meta.build_wheel. Only proxy_tools/__init__.py is executable package code.
